title: deploymentProof
responsibility: Hashes the complete deployment configuration so a plan cannot outlive a changed environment mapping.

inputs.name: deploymentProof.config
inputs.description: Configuration object whose JSON serialization is hashed to bind deployment state to a specific mapping. The digest covers JSON.stringify output, so property order and JSON serialization limits affect the result.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.root
inputs.description: Project directory passed to Git and deployment receipt lookups. Uncaught Git or receipt read failures can reject the check; the symbolic branch lookup alone is caught and treated as empty.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.query
inputs.description: Requested source commit and destination environment used for blocker and promotion checks. Environment must be one of dev, stage, preprod, or prod; prod uses the separate production comparison.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.config
inputs.description: Configuration supplying the source branch and available environment targets for blocker checks. Production comparisons bind stored receipts to deploymentProof(config), and the function does not validate the config.

inputs.name: deploymentHealth.target
inputs.description: Cloudflare target whose healthUrl is fetched to check availability after deployment. Redirects, non-ok responses, timeouts, and fetch errors all resolve to false; the request timeout is 20 seconds.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.root
inputs.description: Project directory passed to plugin discovery, Git checks, and deployment receipt lookups. Discovery or uncaught repository/state read failures reject the check.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.plan
inputs.description: Reviewed deployment plan whose branch, commit, and environment are rechecked, with its promotion comparison also checked for prod. This function does not inspect the plan's expiry or its own blockers.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.guard
inputs.type: { plugin: DeploymentPlugin; fingerprint: string; phase?: string }
inputs.description: Guard containing a DeploymentPlugin, the expected deploymentProof digest, and optional phase text for an in-progress recheck. The plugin has methods that JSON cannot represent; phase is appended to fingerprint-change errors and selects the in-progress blocker error.

outputs.name: deploymentProof
outputs.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of JSON.stringify(config), used to detect deployment configuration changes. It hashes the serialized representation without normalizing property order.

outputs.name: deploymentBlockers
outputs.type: Promise<{ blockers: string[]; branch: string; promotion: { preprod: DeploymentReceipt | null; production: DeploymentReceipt | null; commitsBehind: number | null; }; } | { blockers: string[]; branch: string; promotion: undefined; }>
outputs.description: For non-prod, returns blocker strings, the current branch, and promotion as undefined; for prod, forwards blockers, branch, and the preprod/production comparison. It reports state and target issues but does not perform a deployment.

blockers: Configure both preprod and production deployment targets.
Deploy a verified source commit to preprod first.

outputs.name: deploymentHealth
outputs.description: Promise resolving to true only when the health request returns an ok response without redirects. Fetch failures and the 20-second timeout resolve to false.

outputs.name: deploymentCurrent
outputs.description: Returns the discovered DeploymentConfig, filling an empty sourceBranch from plan.branch. It throws when the fingerprint, production comparison, or blocker state changed; discovery and blocker-check failures also propagate.

errors.name: Deployment proof read or freshness failure
errors.description: deploymentBlockers can reject on uncaught Git or deployment receipt reads. deploymentCurrent throws when the fingerprint, production comparison, or blocker state changed and propagates plugin discovery or blocker-check failures.
